title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect

City: Sao Paulo State: São Paulo (BR-SP) Country: Brazil (BR) Requisition Number: 42598

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Solution Architect. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Values
  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably
Overview

We are looking for an experienced and highly technical professional to join the Business Technology (BT) organization. A Solution Architect creates the overall technical vision for a specific solution to a business problem. They design, describe, and validate the development of the solution. In many ways, this person builds the bridge between a business problem and the technology solution, and outlines each of the phases and requirements required to make that solution work.

Essential Functions
  • Solution Design and Development: Design and guide the development of innovative, globally scalable, efficient and secure solutions such as financial, logistic or manufacturing applications within Bunge. Design, debug, and monitor performance of solutions.
  • Technical leadership: Providing technical leadership to Agile teams and/or DevOps teams throughout the project lifecycle. Identifying the right technologies to use on various projects while considering their performance, price and service agreements.
  • Documentation and Communication: Documenting and sharing knowledge on best practices for new solutions.
  • Proof-of-Concept and Validation. Developing proof-of-concept projects to validate your proposed solutions. Bring a new and alternative perspective when reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members.
  • Strategy: Advise and support business technology leaders to understand, apply, monetize and operationalize existing, new, and emerging technologies to transform automation requirements into scalable and resilient solutions. Demonstrate thought leadership & influence beyond the scope of your own team and throughout Bunge.
Requirements: Education/Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education & experience required, computer science degree preferred.
  • 11+ year of experience in developing large scale, global solutions and leveraging methodologies such Agile, Scrum and DevSecOps.
  • 5+ years of experience required in a similar architectural position, having experience with frameworks like TOGAF ADM. Knowledge of a modeling language like ArchiMate is a pre.
  • Advanced programming skills including automation systems and databases.
  • Familiarity with diverse range of both backend and frontend programming languages, such as Java, C#, Python, SQL, TypeScript, React, CSS and HTML.
  • Integrate cloud automation solutions into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes. Knowledge of Azure DevOps is a pre
  • Ability to manage own work and coach and review the work of others.
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to provide technical guidance and support to other team members.
  • Demonstrated experience in analysis of alternatives and presenting to stakeholders for buy-in and consensus.
  • Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles.
  • A drive and willingness to keep learning Architecture, technologies and methodologies that are new in the market
  • Have a keen eye on details. Your solution designs must be well balanced between workable, pragmatic and future proof.
Other Requirements
  • Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills
  • English spoken at a level that allows discussions and engagement in advanced technical dialogue, is required.
  • Second language of Spanish and/or Portuguese is considered a plus

At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of ~37,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com.

Company Values
  • We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive
  • We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative
  • We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity

If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

Com mais de 6000 colaboradores apaixonados, a Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S.A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. title: Senior Electrical System Engineer - Fuels
description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Brazil is seeking Senior Electrical System Engineer - Fuels , reporting to the Fuel Systems Engineering Manager, working out of the São José dos Campos office.

The Senior Electrical System Engineer - Fuels will work with the Fuel Systems engineering team, within the propulsion organization, to support the integration, development and certification of fuel systems for transport category airplanes. Review documentation and generate artifacts to demonstrate compliance with relevant regulatory and customer requirements, related to electronic, electrical and control systems applied to fuel storage, indicating and distribution functions, as well as developing and implementing electromagnetic/electrostatics analysis and tests for fuels and fuel systems.

Position Responsibilities
  • Leads the Definition, validation, verification and documentation of complex electronic and electrical system requirements.
  • Leads the Definition and coordination of functional and physical interfaces between the fuel system and the vehicle.
  • Leads the development of specifications, architectural and configuration concepts for fuel system electrical and electronic installations to meet customer and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversees and uses various testing, analysis, modeling and simulation tools to estimate or calculate system performance or electromagnetic/electrostatics effects.
  • Defines, performs and reviews certification tests for fuel systems and their components.
  • Solves problems of fielded equipment over the entire product lifecycle. Supports fielded systems to ensure continued reliability.
  • Writes, oversees and reviews teammates work on Functional Hazard Assessments, System Safety Assessment reports, Test Proposals, Test Results, Certifications Plans, and Issue Papers.
  • Coordinates activities with equipment suppliers, certification authorities and other areas to ensure system integration and compliance with requirements.
  • Engineers in this position are expected to work assignments, collaborate with teammates, and receive tasks from lead managers.
  • This position will require occasional national and/or international travel.

This position is hybrid. The selected candidate will be required to perform work onsite at one of the listed location options. This is at the hiring team’s discretion and could potentially change in the future.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)
  • Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.
  • Must have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical/Electronic/Automation engineering field.
  • Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA). Applicable to Brazilian, recent engineering graduates within 6 months and foreign engineers when the employer is willing visa sponsor.
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language.
  • Experience leading electrical/electronic system design, analysis and integration for aircraft.
Preferred Qualifications (Education/Experience)
  • Experience leading Fuel System Electrical Design, Analysis and Certification for transport category airplanes.
  • Experience leading Propulsion System Electrical Design, Analys and Certification for transport category airplanes.
  • Experience leading Fuel quantity indicating systems Design, Analysis and Certification for transport category airplanes.
  • Experience developing and approving electrical system circuit diagrams and schematics.
  • Experience leading electrostatics analysis and testing for fuels.
Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Additional Information

Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil.

Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S. based payroll.

title: Senior Manager, Data System Development
description:
Position title: Senior Manager, Data System Development

Department: Business Planning, Measurement & Innovation

Reporting to: Head of Data System Development

Location: Brazil, Colombia, Denmark, US & UK - Please note that if your right to work in one of the listed locations is not confirmed at the time of applying, C40 will be unable to proceed with your application.

Salary: (Grade 3) Brazil (IC) USD 78,740, Colombia COP 178,360,000, Denmark DKK 686,644, UK GBP £65,318 & US USD 107,670 gross per annum. Due to its commitment to maintain equity and fairness, C40 operates on a spot salary model. This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location.

Term: Fixed term until 31st December 2028 (The appointment and the duration of the role are subject to the final approval of funding).

Background

C40 is a network of nearly 100 mayors of the world’s leading cities, who are working to deliver the urgent action needed right now to confront the climate crisis, and create a future where everyone, everywhere can thrive. Mayors of C40 cities are committed to using a science‑based and people‑focused approach to help the world limit global heating to 1.5°C and build healthy, equitable and resilient communities. Through a Global Green New Deal, mayors are working alongside a broad coalition of representatives from labour, business, the youth climate movement and civil society to go further and faster than ever before.

C40’s team of 400+ staff is based in offices in London, in New York, Johannesburg, Singapore, Delhi, Rio de Janeiro, Copenhagen, Beijing and Paris, and individual staff based across 25+ different locations.

The strategic direction of the organisation is determined by an elected Steering Committee of C40 mayors, which is chaired by Mayor Sadiq Khan of London and Mayor Yvonne Aki‑Sawyerr of Freetown. Three‑term Mayor of New York City Michael R. Bloomberg serves as President of the C40 Board of Directors, responsible for operational oversight. A regionally diverse management team, led by Executive Director Mark Watts, leads the day‑to‑day management of C40. C40’s two core strategic funders are Bloomberg Philanthropies and Realdania.

Our international staff work with the C40 network under the leadership of city governments to deliver this mission. Using a data‑driven approach, our team identifies and promotes the exchange of proven programmes and policies developed by cities; provides world‑class research, technical expertise and access to key partners to deliver new programmes and policies with cities; and communicates cities’ individual achievements and collective leadership.

Diversity Statement

C40 is committed to supporting and promoting equity and diversity and creating an inclusive working environment for everyone. We believe that when people with different life experiences are involved in decision‑making, we deliver better.

We believe having a diverse workforce ensures we connect better with all the different communities and people affected by the climate crisis. This enables us to make better decisions which lead to better outcomes in the work we do through increased creativity, productivity, greater global impact alongside a broader perspective and approach to our work.

We welcome applicants that are diverse in terms of age, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity and perspective. Our goal is for C40 to be an environment where everyone, from any background, can flourish and can be themselves whilst contributing to our mission. If you identify as a person with a disability, we work to provide reasonable appropriate measures and any additional support needed to provide an equitable working experience. If you are living with a disability, chronic illness or neurodiversity please inform us, to provide you with the proper assistance in the application process.

C40 promotes a work culture where staff can input to improve equity, diversity and inclusion through staff‑led groups and formal forums. We know that creating our ideal working environment is a learning process and we are committed to the ongoing effort.

About The Global Covenant of Mayors For Climate & Energy

The Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate and Energy (GCoM or Global Covenant), is a global coalition of cities and local governments with a shared long‑term vision of promoting and supporting voluntary action to combat climate change and move to a low‑carbon, resilient society. The alliance unites and inspires its stakeholders to strengthen global climate coherence, accelerate the energy transition, and generate locally‑tailored solutions for a common purpose: creating an inclusive, just, low‑emission, and climate‑resilient future for all.

Co‑chaired by former New York City Mayor and UN Secretary‑General’s Special Envoy for Climate Ambition and Solutions, Michael R. Bloomberg, and European Commission Executive Vice‑President for a Clean, Just and Competitive Transition, Teresa Ribera, and with the support of global and regional city networks, the Global Covenant of Mayors represents the strongest and clearest signal to national governments that cities are not only acting to stop the effects of climate change, they are leading and leading together. Mayors from across all global regions serve on the Board, and represent city networks, Regional Covenants and bring locally specific perspectives – ensuring that the Global Covenant of Mayors for Climate & Energy is truly led by mayors.

C40 Cities is the fiscal sponsor of the Bloomberg Philanthropies funded parts of the Global Covenant of Mayors (GCoM). As the host organization, C40 provides financial, administrative, and operational services to GCoM. C40 and GCoM are working closely together on aligned programmes and areas of activity.

Position Description:

The Senior Manager, Data System Development is the core technical execution lead, responsible for translating the platform roadmap into a functional, high‑quality product. Reporting to the Head of Data System Development, this role ensures the day‑to‑day development sprints, activities, and tasks are managed effectively, technical architecture meets target user requirements, and all features meet defined specifications in conjunction with the Data System team and associated teams across the GCoM Secretariat and C40. The Senior Manager serves as the in‑house subject matter expert, providing daily technical direction and oversight to external consultants and suppliers and partners, and is accountable for the platform's technical performance and quality.

The Senior Manager, Data System Development is expected to collaborate and coordinate closely with both a Head and Senior Manager of Data System Regions and Partnerships to help ensure that GCoM alliance partner and C40 cities’ needs are sufficiently met, as well as a broader agile team focused on Data System Development, engagement, and delivery.

Responsibilities:
  • Technical architecture and design execution: Translate the platform's strategic vision into detailed technical architecture specifications and designs. Own the execution of implementing architecture changes, including streamlining and redefining the technical specifications for data points that end users – with a focus on cities and local governments need to monitor, report, and showcase impact through data and compelling narratives.
  • Build management and quality assurance: Direct and govern the daily development sprints conducted by external consultants. description:
First Help Financial (FHF) is a fast-growing and culturally diverse company in the U.S. We provide auto loans to the underserved and care for our customers and partners with exceptional service. Through flexible financing options and tri-lingual support, we offer consumers an easier way to finance their first car. We lend to and support our portfolio which has consistently grown 30%+ each year over the last nine years.

Here you will find hard-working colleagues who come from over 20 countries. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of professionalism but also enjoy our work. Our culture and benefits are geared towards making you successful in life and comfortable at work.

Your Title: Quality Assurance Lead.

Your Location: Hybrid/Brazil HQ address - Nações Unidas 12901 - São Paulo - SP (this role requires one day per week in the office on a rotating schedule, plus an additional day in the office each month).

Must be able to speak English AND Portuguese fluently.

Learn more about our awesome Engineering team

About the Opportunity

First Help Financial, voted and certified as a "Great Place to Work" by our workforce for five years in a row, is adding a new partner to our Engineering department to accommodate our remarkable growth! This individual will lead the quality and testing effort for a Scrum Team and push quality process above and beyond standards.

What you will do

Your duties include, but are not limited to:

  • Build and execute manual and automated test cases.
  • Collaborate with other team members, build a long-term quality strategy and drive the successful implementation over time.
  • Provide expertise on the grooming, estimating, and testing of the stories in a sprint.
  • Support scrum team in the creation of proper test cases.
  • Track and report bugs that have been found.
  • Manage testing resources as needed to complete the sprint and overall epic goals.
  • Develop smoke tests, sanity tests, performance, and reliability testing as needed.
  • Provide quality metrics and expert insight into the health of the software.
  • Use appropriate quality tools and infrastructure to scale and manage our testing effort.
  • Enhance and improve the testing methodology for better results, increased productivity, and higher quality, becoming the QA expert in the team.
What you bring
  • Demonstrated career stability with a track record of sustained impact in prior roles.
  • 7+ years of QA experience in an Agile environment, including ownership of testing across multiple releases.
  • Strong automation experience building and maintaining automated tests using tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Postman (or equivalent frameworks/tools).
  • Shift-left quality mindset: bias for action in driving testing and quality advocacy earlier in the development lifecycle.
  • Testing strategy leadership: ability to define and execute a comprehensive testing approach across manual, unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing.
  • Strong grasp of software quality practices including test design techniques, defect lifecycle, CI/CD test integration, and release readiness criteria.
  • Cloud exposure (preferred) with experience testing cloud-hosted applications; AWS strongly preferred.
  • Monitoring/observability experience (preferred) using tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, and/or Grafana to validate releases, troubleshoot issues, and support incident triage.
  • Tool proficiency (preferred): JIRA, TestRail, Postman, and Automation Anywhere (or similar tooling).
  • Metrics-driven approach: experience defining and using testing and operational quality metrics such as test coverage, defect trends, and reliability measures (MTTF, MTTR, MTBF).
  • Analytical and detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills—able to zoom out for big-picture risk assessment while remaining hands-on when needed.
  • Exploratory testing strength with an ability to uncover edge cases and high-risk scenarios.
  • Impact analysis capability: assess downstream risk and identify testing scope for changes across systems/modules.
  • International QA certifications (preferred) such as ISTQB (Foundation/Advanced), CSQA/CSTE, or equivalent industry-recognized credentials.
  • Education (preferred): Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Domain knowledge (preferred): experience with financial software and regulated environments.
  • Great Perks - We offer generous salaries, monthly lunches, a robust employee recognition and talent development program to enhance your career with us.
  • Culture - We are believers in maintaining a healthy work-life balance. While we work hard and care deeply about our customers and partners, we want you to have room for your family, friends, and yourself.
  • Growth - Company growth provides unprecedented career growth. FHF's extraordinary year over year growth in revenue and new markets provides opportunity for you to establish and develop your career growth. We engage each employee to build a career plan that benefits everyone and we have a proven record of investing in you.
Diversity and Inclusion

FHF is committed to building a culture that respects and embraces all walks of life, inclusive of gender, race, culture, age, sexual orientation, and other identities. We will make accommodations when interviewing anyone with special needs.

title: Maintenance Manager, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME (Fulfillment & Operations)
description:
Maintenance Manager, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering Manager is the site lead for all Engineering matters within a building. They are responsible for leading their team and building a culture of safety; for ensuring all statutory compliance requirements are followed to provide a safe working environment for all occupants of the building; for providing a high level of equipment availability to the General Manager or Site Leader and for working with the Global Engineering team to plan for future growth. They are also required to take part in network wide improvement initiatives and to implement standards created elsewhere in the network.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

Key job responsibilities
  • Lead the team, own the annual reporting responsibilities for the team and mentor their direct reports who in turn develop the technicians within the team.
  • Work with the site Safety, Environmental, Sustainability departments & Site Leadership to implement, record and audit Amazon and statutory compliance programs to provide a safe working environment for all staff. Own the legal responsibilities as the site engineering lead within this framework.
  • Work with the recruitment team to ensure allocated headcount is filled with high quality experienced staff. This may include support to Apprentice and Graduate programs.
  • Implement standards validated by the Global Engineering team for the region and participate in continuous improvement initiatives to create or update standards as required in order to provide high levels of safety and equipment availability to our internal customers. A key focus is on preventative maintenance programs.
  • Maintain equipment failure contingency plans, coordinate rehearsals with affected teams and be prepared to work in a flexible manner to ensure failures or breakdowns are rectified as quickly as possible.
  • Maintain a long‑term focus by working with Site Management, Finance, the Global Engineering team and internal design teams to plan for future growth, upgrades or new equipment roll outs.
About the team

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Across Brazil we have several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day.

We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree.
  • Relevant experience of Engineering team leadership.
  • Ability to communicate (written & verbal) in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in project management.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Full working knowledge of all specialized engineering and facilities equipment within the Amazon Customer Fulfillment (CF) as well as maintenance and safety procedures.
  • Experience working with PLC based control systems.
  • Project Management experience.
  • Knowledge of CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) programs.Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Assurance Manager, Risk & Compliance Solutions
description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced Assurance Professional with demonstrated expertise in the EU and UK licensed payment and electronic money services to join our second line of defense (2LoD) assurance team, based in Sao Paulo. The successful candidate will be responsible for executing 2LoD testing/audit-like assurance on our regulated entities across the EU and UK, ensuring our regulated products and services meet regulatory obligations.

The successful candidate is an ambitious self-starter, with a proven capability to work independently and as part of a team, has strong analytical and organizational skills, and a sound knowledge of relevant Assurance or Audit practices. The candidate is ideally responsible for assessing risks, producing regulatory analysis and reports, and designing continuous testing solutions and will work closely with RCS Assurance stakeholders (Compliance Offices, Risk, Governance, Internal Audit and other Operational and Support teams) to provide Senior Management with adequate visibility on regulatory risk exposure and the status of internal controls. The candidate is also a quick learner with an ability to absorb the nuances of Amazon's varied offerings, their risks and internal systems, tools and practices.

Key job responsibilities
  • Perform operational deep dives in regulatory compliance / anti-money laundering, countering terrorism financing (AML/CTF) risk management topics to understand and find gaps in compliance-related processes and services.
  • Work with compliance office personnel, business units legal, and technology partners to identify deficiencies in internal controls and operational processes and identify root cause of issues.
  • Identify and assess inherent and residual risks related to control deficiencies.
  • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge and solid understanding of relevant regulatory requirements across supported jurisdictions (e.g. complaints, safeguarding, AML/CTF, InfoSec, Financial Prudential), in order to effectively assess and deploy a risk-based control testing plan.
  • Ability to learn and understand business processes, regulations, internal controls, and develop meaningful tests to determine control design adequacy and operating effectiveness.
  • Support issue validation activities with stakeholders and report findings/outcomes to Senior Management.
  • Leverage data analytics to increase value and reduce costs of compliance-related assurance activities.
  • Manage several projects simultaneously with precision and accuracy.
About The Team

Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) is Amazon’s financial crime and regulatory compliance gate keeper for licensed payment and e-money activities. The team supports Amazon's regulated entities across the EU and UK to implement 2LoD controls that enable them to demonstrate compliance with regulation and manage their risk effectively. We do this while keeping customers at heart.

Basic Qualifications
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
  • Experience communicating complex business concepts in verbal and written form
  • Experience in compliance, audit or risk management
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Demonstrate knowledge of EU and UK regulations
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's degree
  • Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
  • Knowledge of ICT and Financial Prudential

What skills do I need?

  • Experience working with relational databases in production environments (MySQL, Aurora, PostgreSQL, Oracle), including query optimization and performance tuning

  • Written and spoken English
  • Ability to translate user requirements into technical solutions
  • Ability to quickly master new technologies
  • Ability to work independently
  • Be a team player
What do we offer?
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever‑evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded

Flexibility in how you work:

We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.

Descrição da Vaga

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos. Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio . Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

title: Directeur (F/H) - Alliance française de Buenos Aires (Argentine)
description:
Description synthétique du poste

Sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC) et sous la responsabilité du Conseil d'administration (CA) de l’Alliance française de Buenos Aires (AFBA), association de droit local, vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement. Vous assurez le bon fonctionnement et développement de l’Alliance ainsi que le suivi de l’ensemble des actions qui y sont menées, en conformité avec les lois locales. En tant que coordinateur du réseau national des Alliances Françaises, vous participez à la mise en oeuvre de la coopération linguistique, universitaire et culturelle de l’ambassade de France. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre par le COCAC votre lettre de mission. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l'approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.

Activités principales

Les 4 antennes de l'AFBA (Belgrano, Palermo Fortabat, Flores, Martinez) sont dotées de 4 galeries, 1 auditorium, 1 médiathèque, 1 bibliothèque, 1 espace VR immersif et tiers-lieu, 1 cafétéria. Dans ce cadre, vous serez responsable de :

  • L’élaboration, la proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l’Alliance française de Buenos Aires, l’une des plus importantes du réseau mondial.
  • Représenter et d’administrer l’établissement.
  • Développer et assurer le suivi des activités linguistiques et culturelles de l’établissement (budget, nombre étudiants différents à l’année).
  • Dynamiser la programmation culturelle (316 événements différents en 2024 pour 11.295 spectateurs).
  • Participer à la mise en place d’outils d’analyse, de suivi et d’évaluation, à l’élaboration du budget annuel, à la gestion du personnel.
  • Établir d’étroites relations avec les réseaux professionnels et les autorités du pays, développer des partenariats avec les entreprises, les administrations, entités et associations.
  • Préparer et remettre des rapports réguliers d’activité au Conseil d’administration, à la Fondation des Alliances françaises et au Conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle.
  • En tant coordinateur du réseau national des Alliances françaises : Conseiller et apporter expertise aux 53 alliances du réseau argentin, coordonner les politiques de développement du réseau (professionnalisation, démarche qualité, modernisation, immobilier, équipement), les formations nationales des personnels, la gestion des examens et la programmation culturelle commune aux alliances du pays.
Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions

Master 2 ou équivalent. Expérience avérée de directeur d’Alliance française, expérience du montage d’évènements culturels et de mise en place de partenariats institutionnels internationaux, marketing. Excellente formation en français langue étrangère indispensable.

title: Jeugdzorgwerker C - Jonge meiden
description:
Werk je graag met jonge meiden die in hun leven tegen moeilijkheden zijn aangelopen en niet meer thuis kunnen wonen? Wil je hen begeleiden richting zelfstandigheid? En sta je stevig in je schoenen? Kom dan werken bij Timon. Bekijk de vacature jeugdzorgwerker C bij Ziva in Utrecht Tuindorp.

Ziva in Utrecht is een verblijfvoorziening met zelfstandigheidstraject voor meiden 16-22 jaar. Zij beschikken over enorme veerkracht en willen bij Ziva stappen zetten in hun persoonlijke ontwikkeling. De volgende thema’s komen vaak terug: angst- en stemmingsproblematiek, zelfbeschadiging en suïcide, trauma en hechting, agressie en drugsgebruik. De meiden hebben zelf de regie over hun traject, als mentor begeleid je hen in de uitdagingen die zij hierin tegenkomen.

Warmte, nabijheid, geduld en doorzettingsvermogen

Dat vraagt van jou als jeugdzorgwerker C om warmte, nabijheid, geduld en doorzettingsvermogen. In stressvolle situaties kun je adequaat handelen en ben je flexibel. Als de situatie daarom vraagt, neem je het initiatief en behoud je het overzicht. Belangrijk is een niet veroordelende houding waarbij de regie bij de jongere gelaten wordt. Verder wordt het samenwerken met het systeem (netwerk en GGZ) gezien als een essentieel onderdeel van de begeleiding.

Jouw werk doet ertoe

Als jeugdzorgwerker C ben je mentor van een aantal jongeren. Je begeleidt hen 1-op-1. Je motiveert en ondersteunt de jongere in het behalen van haar doelen. Je krijgt energie van het individuele groeiproces van de jongere en elk stapje zie als winst. Je houdt de veiligheid in het oog en werkt aan het creëren van een stabiele omgeving. Vanuit je hart en je deskundigheid begeleid je jongeren naar zelfstandigheid. Daarbij betrek je ook het netwerk rondom de jongere.

Je wordt onderdeel van een enthousiast team waarbij je meedraait op onze locatie, ook in het avond en weekend. In deze diensten ben je aanspreekpunt van alle meiden op onze locatie.

Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de begeleiding van de jongeren
  • Je stelt samen met de jongere doelen op en legt die vast in het hulpverleningsplan
  • Je hebt veel vrijheid om je begeleiding vorm te geven, passend bij wat op dat moment nodig is
  • Je bent contactpersoon voor én tussen ouders/(gezins)voogden, scholen en andere betrokken instanties
  • Je gaat teamoverstijgende taken doen, zoals roosters maken, HR-taken, intakes, instroom en het voorzitten van vergaderingen

“Ik bouw graag mee aan stabiliteit, er mogen zijn en een glimlach. Met liefde als basis, wat inhoudt dat we iedere jongere een tweede kans geven.”

Frouke Procee, jeugdzorgwerker C

Dit vragen we van je
  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Minimaal twee jaar ervaring in de (jeugd)zorg
  • Je hebt kennis van behandelmethodes, zoals Contextueel, Wrap Around Care, Beschermjassen en SOS) en wilt hierin leren en groeien
  • Vereiste: Registratie in het beroepsregister SKJ (Stichting Kwaliteitskader Jeugd
Dit bieden wij

Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 8) vanaf € 2946,27 tot € 4375,20afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract van 32 uur. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband.
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris

Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie zoals: Verbindend Gezag en Competentiegericht Werken.

Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Al onze collega's werken vanuit een christelijke geloofsovertuiging. Wij verlenen zorg aan iedereen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met bijna 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor jeugdzorgwerker C. Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

title: Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI)
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical's growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Partner Sales Director to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu-based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long‑term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.

Reporting to the VP Global Alliances and Channels, the Partner Sales Director will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership, and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level. They will own the strategy, the sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with the GSI and will animate many customer workshops, sales events, public presentations and executive engagements.

The role entails
  • Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
  • Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
  • Ability to travel – sometimes internationally – up to 40% of the time
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands‑on, get‑it‑done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast‑paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
What we offer colleagues
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Summary

We’re looking for a visionary Principal Development Architect to join SAP’s Business Data Cloud Technology Office — a central team driving the future of SAP’s data management strategy. description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Supervisor Regional de Vendas - SUL
description:
Especialista em Recrutamento Estratégico no Grupo Moas | Atração e Seleção | Talent Acquisition | Psicóloga

Nós acreditamos que cada talento faz parte de uma construção coletiva. No Grupo Moas, buscamos pessoas que compartilhem dos nossos valores e estejam dispostas a criar conexões que transformam vidas.

Como Supervisor Regional de Vendas – SUL , você será responsável por liderar, desenvolver e impulsionar equipes comerciais em sua região, garantindo a execução das estratégias de vendas e o alcance dos resultados planejados. Atuará diretamente no acompanhamento de metas, no desenvolvimento de representantes e na ampliação da presença da marca nos mercados locais.

Sua atuação será essencial para fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes e parceiros, identificar oportunidades de crescimento e implementar ações que promovam a excelência em atendimento e rentabilidade sustentável. Além disso, será responsável por analisar indicadores de desempenho, propor melhorias nos processos comerciais e assegurar o alinhamento das práticas regionais com as diretrizes estratégicas da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Gerir a equipe comercial regional – SUL (vendedores, representantes ou promotores), acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e resultados;

Garantir a execução da estratégia comercial da Buba e Buba Care no ponto de venda: exposição, mix, precificação, giro e margem;

Prospectar novas oportunidades de negócio e expansão de cobertura geográfica e de canais;

Acompanhar e analisar o desempenho das vendas por linha de produto (puericultura leve, pesada, brinquedos, acessórios etc);

Implementar campanhas e ações promocionais alinhadas ao marketing e trade marketing da Buba e Buca Care ;

Elaborar relatório de resultados, análises de mercado e concorrência;

Apoiar o planejamento de demanda e o controle de estoques regionais;

Garantir o cumprimento das metas de faturamento, rentabilidade e distribuição numérica da marca;

Treinar e capacitar a equipe e os parceiros comerciais quanto a produtos, políticas e cultura Buba Buba Care .

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;

Vivência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em supervisão de vendas regionais, preferencialmente no setor puericultura, brinquedos, infantil ou bens de consumo;

Conhecimento de canais varejo, atacado e distribuidores regionais;

Disponibilidade total para viagens;

Desejável: vivência prévia com com players do mesmo segmento (ex: Chicco, NUK, Lillo, Philips Avent, MAM, Multikids Baby etc.).

Competências – Chave:

Liderança inspiradora e foco em resultados;

Comunicação clara e assertiva;

Adaptabilidade a diferentes perfis de clientes e regiões;

Negociação e gestão de equipes externas;

Perfil analítico, organizado;

Visão estratégica e orientação comercial.

Local de trabalho: Regional SUL.

Salário: compatível ao mercado.

Obs.: Todas as viagens são custeadas pela empresa.

Criando conexões com propósito: esse é o Nosso Jeito

No Grupo Moas, acreditamos no poder das conexões. Somos um time apaixonado por qualidade, movido por inovação e guiado por valores sólidos como cuidado, transparência, respeito e colaboração. Desde 2003, crescemos com o olhar atento de quem entende que bem-estar se constrói com sensibilidade e funcionalidade.

Na jornada das famílias, desenvolvemos produtos de puericultura, cuidados com a pele e momentos especiais com os pequenos — sempre com segurança, afeto e responsabilidade.

Já no universo da casa, inspiramos pessoas a criarem ambientes com alma, unindo curadoria, design contemporâneo e acessibilidade.

Conecte-se ao nosso propósito

Hoje, as marcas do Grupo Moas somam mais de 1 milhão de seguidores nas redes sociais e encantam e impactam mais de 10 milhões de pessoas todos os meses. Um alcance que reflete a força da nossa essência: criar conexões reais entre pessoas, lares e histórias.

Se você compartilha dessa essência e quer crescer junto com um grupo que valoriza o desenvolvimento, o bem-estar e a criatividade coletiva, o Grupo Moas é o seu lugar.

Are you a commercially driven leader with a deep understanding of the Brazilian or Argentinian market and a passion for building growth from the ground up? You will have the freedom to shape strategy, build partnerships, and accelerate business growth for a fast-scaling international company.

About the Role

The Country Manager will serve as the strategic and commercial driver of business development in Brazil or Argentina. You will be responsible for designing and executing a market strategy that increases revenue, strengthens brand presence, and builds long‑term partnerships. This role offers significant autonomy and visibility, making it ideal for someone who thrives on responsibility and high‑impact leadership.

  • Lead growth and revenue expansion in the Brazilian or Argentinian market.

  • Long‑term development within a rapidly growing international organization.

Why Brazil or Argentina?

Brazil and Argentina offer two of the most exciting business environments in Latin America. With expanding digital economies, dynamic consumer markets, and strong entrepreneurial energy, both countries present enormous opportunities for growth. Whether in the fast‑paced economic hub of São Paulo or the vibrant commercial landscape of Buenos Aires, this role combines professional challenge with the opportunity to build something truly scalable and impactful.

If you're a decisive commercial leader ready to take on a high‑visibility role and shape market success across Brazil or Argentina, this opportunity provides the ideal platform to achieve it.

description:
There are 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we’re all about at John Deere. And it’s why we’re investing in our people and our technology like never before in our 175-year history. Here the world’s brightest minds are tackling the world’s biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we’ll put you to work. RIGHT NOW.

Primary Location: Brazil (BR)- Sao Paulo- Indaiatuba
Function: Technology (CA)
Title: Senior Software Engineer - Software Engineering )-

Your Position:

Descrição longa

As a Senior Software Engineer at John Deere, based in the Indaiatuba/SP unit, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining applications using Java and Node.js, leveraging AWS services (including serverless architectures), as well as contributing to the creation of automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions. You will also work on infrastructure automation with Terraform and manage both SQL and NoSQL databases. We are looking for someone with Intermediate to advanced technical English, experience in developing complex software solutions, and a strong interest in innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration in agile environments.

Descrição longa
  • Lead the development and maintenance of applications using Java, Node;
  • Design and implement scalable and highly available distributed systems, ensuring robustness and efficiency of solutions; Collaborate in the use of AWS cloud services for the development and deployment of innovative solutions, including serverless architectures;
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of unit, integration, and end-to-end (e2e) tests to ensure software quality;
  • Assist in the implementation and management of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins;
  • Use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform to efficiently manage and provision infrastructure;
  • Participate in the implementation of observability practices using NewRelic and Open Telemetry for performance monitoring and analysis;
  • Work collaboratively with the team to promote best development practices and innovation;
  • Design and implement solutions with Relational databases, ensuring efficiency in data storage and retrieval.
Descrição longa
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field;
  • Intermediate/advanced English for reading and technical communication;
  • Experience in design, development, testing and integration of high complex software solutions;
  • Proficiency in one modern programing languaguges(e.g. Node, TypesScript, Java etc.);
  • Experience working with AWS Cloud Services;
  • Knowledge of software testing practices, including unit, e2e, and integration tests;
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions; Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform;
  • Experience with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB);
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring with NewRelic and Open Telemetry.
Descrição longa
  • Experience in leading and contributing to complex software projects;
  • Experience in API First design approach using OpenAI;
  • Appetite for continuous learning and willingness to develop deep technical skills and collaborate with other team members and contribute to their professional development;
  • Ability to innovate and implement effective technical solutions;
  • Experience in agile environments and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Get At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. We offer comprehensive relocation and reward packages to help you get started on your new career path. Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package

title: Subsea Engineer
description:
A 2H Offshore é uma empresa global de engenharia especializada no projeto, análise e gestão de integridade de estruturas offshore, sistemas submarinos, risers e condutores. Atuamos em todo o espectro energético - do petróleo e gás às energias renováveis - oferecendo soluções inovadoras e robustas para os desafios offshore mais complexos do mundo.

Nosso escritório no Brasil está crescendo e buscamos novos talentos para apoiar projetos de desenvolvimento de campos - novos e maduros - para um importante operador no país. Estamos contratando profissionais experientes em Engenharia Submarina de diversas disciplinas para integrar nossa equipe no Rio de Janeiro.

Se você tem experiência em engenharia submarina e já atuou em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas, queremos conhecer você:

  • Sistemas e equipamentos submarinos de produção
  • Dutos e linhas de fluxo (pipelines e flowlines)
  • Controles submarinos e umbilicais
  • Engenharia de instalação (rígidos, flexíveis, umbilicais)
  • Suprimentos e interface com fornecedores
  • Gestão de integridade e extensão da vida útil de ativos
  • Arquitetura de campo e configuração de sistemas

Essa é uma excelente oportunidade para trabalhar em projetos de grande impacto, desde o conceito até a execução e operação. Você fará parte de uma equipe colaborativa e altamente técnica, que valoriza inovação, compartilhamento de conhecimento e excelência na entrega.

  • Formação em engenharia (mecânica, civil, offshore, subsea ou áreas correlatas)
  • Experiência comprovada em sistemas submarinos, equipamentos ou engenharia de instalação
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e boa capacidade de comunicação
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro
  • Interesse em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar

Na 2H, oferecemos um ambiente onde engenheiros têm autonomia, crescem tecnicamente e entregam resultados significativos desde o primeiro dia. Se você é especialista ou generalista, e tem paixão por engenharia submarina, queremos ouvir você.

Envie seu CV em inglês e venha fazer parte do nosso time.

Vamos juntos construir o futuro da energia offshore.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.

Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.

Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.

Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.

Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.

Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management

Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.

Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.

Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.

Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.

Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.

Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.

Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.

If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.

Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.

Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.

Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

Cross-reference Salesforce ? Wrike and Wrike ? NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.

Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.

Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.

Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.

Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.

Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.

Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.

Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.

Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.

Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.

Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.

Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

Monitor workload balance across consultants.

Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.

Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills

Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)

Working Knowledge Of JIRA, Salesforce, Required, And NetSuite Preferred.

Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

Engenheiro de controle de instrumentação Woodgrove Technologies Inc. • Cachoeirinha, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like‑minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.

Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Instrumentation and Control department that works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site). We deploy and integrate optimization solutions. This role is ideal for someone who has a passion to engineer real‑world solutions.

All resumes must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities
  • Design and engineering of instrumentation and control systems.
  • Design, sizing, and selection of instruments (valves, flow meters, pressure transmitters, etc.).
  • Design and drafting of P&ID's.
  • On-site commissioning.
  • Remote support of mineral processing plants.
  • Producing technical documentation (functional descriptions, instrument lists, instrument datasheets, reports, specifications, drawings).
  • Conducting feasibility studies (with focus on instrumentation and control, operations optimization).
  • Conducting data and control loop analysis.
  • R&D initiatives for developing innovative solutions for the mineral processing industry.
Job Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical / Instrumentation / Control Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience within the process industry.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Knowledge of and experience with AutoCAD Plant 3D (P&ID) or similar design software packages.
  • Knowledge of and experience with control systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.) and/or loop tuning.
  • English: conversation level.

Coordenar a equipe de planejamento regulatório.

Supervisionar análises de fluxo de caixa, indicadores contratuais e impactos regulatórios.

Atuar como principal interlocutor com Jurídico, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e consultorias externas.

Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas a reequilíbrios contratuais, investimentos e pleitos.

Garantir governança, qualidade técnica e consistência das informações apresentadas.

Atuar fortemente na gestão com visão integrada do contrato.

Experiência sólida em planejamento regulatório, concessões, PPPs ou gestão de contratos complexos.

Forte domínio de análises econômico-financeiras e visão estratégica.

Capacidade de liderança, coordenação e desenvolvimento de equipe.

Perfil analítico, com boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação com múltiplos stakeholders.

Benefícios :
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);

description:
Technical Product Manager | Bees Platform

Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

ABI’s Growth Group is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses.

ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

What you’ll do:
  • Lead complex product initiatives with multiple dependencies across B2B (BEES), DTC, and platform capabilities
  • Influences and executes product roadmaps with technical feasibility analysis and cross‑functional coordination
  • Write and maintain technical PRDs, system diagrams, and API/integration specifications to guide engineering squads
  • Partner closely with engineering, data, and architecture teams to design end‑to‑end platform capabilities
  • Lead cross‑domain alignment between product teams, engineering squads, and global stakeholders
  • Care about outcomes, not just output — measure success through reliability, performance, and real user impact
What you’ll need: Technical Foundation:
  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • 4‑6 years experience in technical product management for platform/infrastructure products
  • Comfortable navigating conversations about architecture, scalability, and integration — from microservices and event‑driven systems to cloud infrastructure
  • Hands‑on ability to query and analyze data with SQL; familiarity with analytics tools
Product & Leadership:
  • Experience writing technical product specs, system diagrams, and managing inter‑service dependencies
  • Proven ability to lead large‑scale initiatives that span multiple technical domains and stakeholder groups
  • Strong communication skills — you can translate deep technical concepts for both engineers and executives
  • Experience collaborating across frontend, backend, and infrastructure layers
Growth Group Mindset:
  • Passion for building foundational platforms that power multiple products and geographies
  • Driven by technical curiosity and the desire to make complex systems simple and reliable
  • Comfortable in fast‑changing, ambiguous environments with evolving priorities
  • Think economically — focuses on maximizing business impact per engineering hour
What We Offer:
  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
